verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 Data Access API spec on SwaggerHub, and its developer portal renders an API reference generated from that spec, with Authentication, Pagination, Rate Limiting and Versioning pages. That is a real first-party structured reference. However, no evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes on docs.bugsnag.com returned 404. Missing for 10: documented interactive try-it-out console, runnable code examples, hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference experience.
